question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you think Matteo should have given up on Zoe?
What do you think of Matteo?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I'm the new transfer at Centerscore. I just arrived this morning.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So you thought you'd come and see $ZOE first.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I have not talked with her in a long time. I imagine a lot of things have changed since the last time we saw each other.
Matteo feels the small gift box for $ZOE in his jacket pocket.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I want another chance to tell $ZOE how I feel about her...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I've come all this way, $ZOE. Is it possible for us to hang out this afternoon and catch up?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: She's busy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Howard.` Don't be rude.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Howard.[/i][/color] Don't be rude.

nodes.text: $ZOE turns to Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We made plans to hike around Centerscore today.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, what if we all travel together? Erik is my host, and he has graciously offered to take me on his wonderful Star Tour of Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't think that's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, he's come all this way. We can all hang out together. Just for old time's sake, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, if Erik's coming... Sure.
Matteo darts in and closes the door quickly just as Howard enters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you...?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, I heard voices. Is Sam home?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No... Sam has swim practice all day today.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then who...
Howard turns to the closet door as it creaks back open, revealing Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Surprise?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, what's going on? Why is Matteo hiding in there?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're going to have to ask him that.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I must look so foolish...
Matteo steps out and stands in front of Howard and $ZOE.
Matteo resists the urge to hide, just as Howard enters the room and spots him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you remember Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Hello, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What are `you` doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I was in the area.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's a likely story. It's not like Paris is the next town over.
For an instant, Matteo panics. He looks around the room for an escape and sees the open pantry.
Matteo pulls himself up to $ZOE's window and gives Erik a cheerful wave.
Erik gives him a thumbs-up.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're like Captain Quarch, scrambling up the balcony to warn General Kataya of the alien army's impending invasion!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Uh, thanks?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Don't mention it! Go save the Imperial Fleet!
Matteo nods, turns back to the window, and knocks on it.
The window opens, revealing a surprised $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Matteo?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Matteo?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You... You're here!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why are you outside my window?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, I...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No wait. Get off the ledge and then answer that.
$ZOE steps aside to let Matteo into her room.
Matteo lands in the rose bushes just outside the house!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: `Aaaahhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aaaahhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no! Matteo, don't move... I know CPR!
Matteo bursts out of the roses and fights his way past the thorny underbrush.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just so you know... I'm an expert on spleen injuries...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is all right, my friend. I will be fine.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know Captain Quarch used the balcony of General Kataya's bedroom to quickly warn her of the alien army invasion that was coming...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But maybe you should try the door this time.
From above them, a window opens... And $ZOE pokes her head out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is going on out here?
$ZOE looks at Matteo, and her eyes widen. She shuts her window, and a minute later, the door opens.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe it's really you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Did you just fall into our rose bushes?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Uh, yes, unfortunately. I did not mean for you to see me like this...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why don't you just come in?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Erik too.
$ZOE steps aside to let them both inside.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE, it is good to see you! It has been a long time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I'm glad to see you too, but... I didn't know you were in town.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you visiting?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh, it is more than just a visit. I'm the new exchange student at Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I could say that I was here only to experience America, to live a different life, to learn to love your version of football...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But in truth, signorina, I came to be near you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo... That's very sweet of you. And I'm flattered you'd transfer just for me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm with Howard now, and I don't think anything is going to change that.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Perhaps not, but you should listen to what I have to say...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This wasn't how I thought it would go... I'm starting to think that coming here was all a mistake...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You really should go. Howard's here right now, and if he sees you...
Just then, Matteo hears the sound of footsteps coming down the hall.
Matteo feels his muscles buckle! He falls back!
Matteo feels his muscles buckle! He falls back!
Matteo steels himself and climbs up the last few feet!
Matteo feels his muscles buckle! He falls back!
Matteo lets go, and he falls back!
Matteo grabs the pipe tightly and keeps climbing!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This house is high! My arms are getting tired!
Matteo lets go, and he falls back!
Matteo pulls himself up with enough force to free his leg!
He climbs until his grip slips on a wet piece of pipe!
Matteo fumbles and slips down!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, does $ZOE know you're coming?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I have not told her. I was afraid she would reject me or think I was crazy...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Plus, surprises are always best for this kind of thing.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What do you think she'll say?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She will run to me. She must. We had a spark. I am confident she has been thinking of me too.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I will walk up to her, tell her how I feel, and give her this necklace that represents my love!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If you're going to do that, we'd better go to her house right away!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I appreciate your spirit, my friend. Let us go!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: ...But how is it we are getting there?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I got a side car attachment for my bike this Christmas!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The Erik-Mobile can now seat one person comfortably and one person uncomfortably!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am happy to see my home, Italia, and this country are not so different.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: In Italy, I also have a sidecar for my motor scooter.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They're the same!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Except for that 'motor' part...
And an hour later, Erik bikes his way up to $ZOE's house.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Here we are!
Matteo jumps out of the sidecar.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Fantastico! Your energy is truly boundless.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... I'm a little tired. Who knew two people would be twice as heavy as one?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Ah, you are amusing, my funny friend! Thank you for the ride.
Matteo turns to the house and sees pink, ruffled curtains through one of the windows. From the window, Matteo can hear $ZOE humming to herself.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It's time, Erik. If you will excuse me, I am going to climb up to her window...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're climbing up?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: That is the only way to confess your feelings. In one romantic gesture!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What if she doesn't want you scaling her house?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Sometimes you have to take a risk.
Matteo looks at the house, spies the water pipe, and starts to climb it.
He gets halfway up when his pant leg catches on a string of Christmas lights!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh no! It is dragging me down!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You've missed her for half a year, and you're only going to say 'hi'?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If I liked a girl, I'd tell her right away...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I admit that might be a less passionate approach than I am used to.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You believe I should be more open?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But the last time we talked, she did choose another guy over me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I used to date a girl who wouldn't tell me if we were even dating!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So I believe you should always be honest in relationships.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You are right. I should be more upfront with my love! Explosive, even!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sounds dangerous!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How romantic!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Do you think she loves you back?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I... I am not entirely certain. When we were in Paris, it seemed she could have loved me. But now that we have been apart...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is hard to tell.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But she must know how I feel about her! I cannot give up on our love!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I tell the girl I like that I like her all the time!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Exactly. Men like us are men of action.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That makes me sound so cool!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, I'm done with my meal. Everyone ready to go?
They walk out of the restaurant into the outdoor courtyard.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, that concludes the `Star Tour of Centerscore!` I hope everyone had a good time!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, that concludes the [color=#e23b3b][i]Star Tour of Centerscore![/i][/color] I hope everyone had a good time!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If you'd like to file any compliments or complaints, leave them at Centerscore High, Locker 267!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even though it was a tour of our school and Howard's neighborhood, I really enjoyed myself.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who knew the Mad Egger of Maple Street still lurks around every Halloween, waiting for his opportunity to strike?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thank you, Erik. It was a surprisingly informative tour.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I'm ready to head back home now...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Hey, before our evening ends, and we part until school starts up...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Would you two mind if $ZOE and I get a moment alone to talk? I promise it will only take a minute.
Erik excuses himself to head to Howard's car, but Howard hesitates and turns to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Will you be all right?
$ZOE kisses Howard on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll meet you at the car soon.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right...
Howard follows Erik.
Alone in the garden, Matteo takes $ZOE's hand.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE, today has been wonderful. It has made me so happy to see you again.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's been nice to see you as well.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I brought you something from Italy. It is a late holiday gift...
Matteo holds out the gift to $ZOE. She opens it and draws out an amethyst, teardrop pendant on a thin, silver chain.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is beautiful... Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am happy you like it. But that is not the reason I wanted to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it?
Matteo takes in a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I know that you are with Howard, but what I am asking is for you to answer one question for me.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: If you can honestly tell me that you do not have any feelings for me...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I will give up.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Tell me I am alone in this, and I will go home and force myself to forget everything we had.
$ZOE bites her lip.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was really magical?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh, $ZOE, we visited Rhodes. It looks exactly like a medieval city!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It even has cobblestone streets.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You can walk anywhere, and it feels like you are a knight on patrol hundreds of years ago.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And the ocean we visited was blue as the sky and so clear that you could see straight through to the bottom...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That does sound amazing.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The ocean starts to look the same after awhile, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: In Greece, the ocean is unforgettable.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I wished you had been there, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I do too... It sounds wonderful. Traveling with you would be so fun!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We woke up early every morning, ran on trails, and climbed up mountains until the late afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Ate dinner as if wolves were upon us...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And fell asleep as soon as our heads hit our pillows...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It was a wonderful experience. We did so much in every day!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE, I wish you had been there. You would have been able to keep pace with the best of us!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know if I would have liked waking up too early. That vacation sounds almost too stressful.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It seems I'm more of a homebody these days.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard and I like to have relaxing evenings in front of the TV, eating popcorn, and watching the twins.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I can imagine you must have had a lot of fun.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Yes, I did...
They eat the rest of their meal, while having a pleasant conversation.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, Matteo, what is Europe like? Do all the waiters and waitresses there hurl coffee like how Cupid shoots arrows?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do not know where you are getting your information, my friend, but no, that is not the case.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: At least, not where I've traveled.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Of course, I have never been to Norway! All the places I have visited in Europe are very different.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What's your favorite city?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I would have to say Paris. It is the city I love most above all others.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Some of my best memories were made there.
Matteo catches $ZOE's eye, and she looks down.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So... What's fun to do in Europe? I'll admit, last time we went, I didn't do a lot of sightseeing...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is great fun to get into the culture and experience life the way other people do.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Before I came here, I went to Greece with my parents.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Was it really hot?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did you meet a Medusala?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you have fun?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: 'Yes' to Howard. A definite 'no' to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And, $ZOE... I had so much fun. You would have loved it.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Our trip was...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I tried spicy once, and I hated it.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Sometimes you should take a second chance on something you've already tried.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Besides, there are different kinds of spicy. You might find you enjoy this kind.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not me! Spicy things make my mouth feel like a party only adults go to!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It just tastes like fire to me. But I'll give it a shot.
The group places their order, and twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Open up! Penne arrabiata...
$ZOE takes a tentative bite... And starts coughing!
Her eyes start watering up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Water... Water...
Howard hands her a glass, and $ZOE downs it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Here, take a bite of something non-spicy like our salad.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Some things are worth trying... And some are definitely not...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am sorry, $ZOE. Perhaps you will never become accustomed to spicy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Trying something new was probably good, so thanks for that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Otherwise, I never would have known that food could hurt so much...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, that sounds... I don't even know how that sounds!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Squids use that stuff to repel other animals. Why would you `eat` that?
nodes.text_bbcode: Squids use that stuff to repel other animals. Why would you [color=#e23b3b][i]eat[/i][/color] that?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It will be fun... What is the worst that can happen?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Death by squid...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My parents tried to get me to eat a seafood pasta one time, but I just couldn't do it!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This is an opportunity then! When life gives you a second chance, you should take it!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Maybe you will `love` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe you will [color=#e23b3b][i]love[/i][/color] it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay. I'll try it.
The group places their order, and twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, the noodles are jet black...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cool!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Open up! Squid ink pasta...
$ZOE takes a tentative bite...
Chews thoughtfully...
And smiles!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ... Whoa. This is really good!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, you should try this...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, I don't think so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww, come on, Howard. Don't tell me you're scared.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... Just grossed out. I don't think pasta should be that color...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, fine. Maybe I'll just share Matteo's dish with him...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Have as much as you like. See? What'd I tell you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're right... Trying new things is great!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I will tell her... I'll tell her right after the tour!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You can go now! Don't let us stand in the way of your love...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No, I can't. A tour guide never leaves his tourists! It's the sacred code!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If I'm going to talk to Sara about her feelings for me... What are you going to do about $ZOE?
Matteo looks over to where $ZOE and Howard are holding hands.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Later on, I plan to ask if she still cares for me the way she did in Paris.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But for now... I just have to be the good friend $ZOE expects me to be.
$ZOE and Howard wander back.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is everyone ready to go?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How much longer does the tour go on?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: After a quick jaunt past Festival Drive to see the house belonging to the illustrious Party Man Hector Hector Alonzo...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We stop for dinner! It's included! Now come!
Half an hour later, they arrive at the hostess station of a nice, Italian restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Here we are! I chose this restaurant because it's where the stars eat. All three and a half of them!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Three and a half?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think he's talking about the rating.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I also hear this is the spot where everyone is getting New Year's Eve dinner. In fact, `I'm` coming here right before my Ogres and Elves New Year's Party!
nodes.text_bbcode: I also hear this is the spot where everyone is getting New Year's Eve dinner. In fact, [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] coming here right before my Ogres and Elves New Year's Party!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE and I have been here before...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Exactly! And that table over there is where Hector and Amanda first fought as a couple!
A waitress approaches the group.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Erik Ericson! You brought another tour around for us. We're getting quite busy off your customers.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: I was worried after the way your last tour group argued.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, that was fine. Christina and Sarah are great now! They were just really eager to see the place where Colt and Denni kissed for the second time!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm kind of glad we skipped over that on our tour.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Seriously.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: I'll go see about your table.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Who is this Denni and Colt? Are they some kind of couple?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh they wish!
The waitress comes back over.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Erik, we're a little busy tonight, but you'll get your table in a few minutes. Please sit and relax.
They settle in for a short wait.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So, Matteo... Have a new girlfriend yet?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No, not at the moment. I dated a few girls... Ten or fifteen or so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fifteen?!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But I could not find happiness with any of them. They just simply did not compare. I dated a girl seriously for a month.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But we broke up a couple weeks ago. I... I was not into it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, a guy like you will have good luck here in Centerscore. Lots of girls. `Single girls.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, a guy like you will have good luck here in Centerscore. Lots of girls. [color=#e23b3b][i]Single girls.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Somehow I think I will run into the same problem.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...So, you dated how many girls?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I've upset her by telling her... But she doesn't know I dated so many to forget her!
At that moment, three Monarch Prep girls enter the area.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And then I told the salesgirl, 'Hello! These gold shoes aren't going to gild themselves!'

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: That's awesome, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I'm a little confused... Why get gold shoes if you can get them in platinum?
Howard smiles at Paige and waves her over.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Since we were talking about girls... I thought I'd wave one over.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, Howard... Did you decide to ditch Sam's lame cousin and start dating me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No, but I have someone else here you might be interested in. Matteo, this is Paige. Paige, Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey there, handsome.
Paige puts a hand on Matteo's arm.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Uh, hello, American girl.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can call me Paige. I have to say... I `love` your Italian accent...
nodes.text_bbcode: You can call me Paige. I have to say... I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] your Italian accent...

nodes.text: Matteo backs into a wall.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I need to get this girl away from me before $ZOE gets the wrong idea.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Thank you for your interest, beautiful girl...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You think I'm beautiful?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Er... How could I not?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What'd I say?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I cannot stop flirting!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I don't want to be rude, but I need to let her down easy!

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Push Paige away!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know what I love about the Italians?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I cannot even begin to guess.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Your country. I'd love to hear where you're from. Do you want to tell me all the details over dinner?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I can only give you my regrets...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am sorry. You are very beautiful, but I cannot have dinner with you.
Matteo gestures to $ZOE.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: My friends are with me, and I could not abandon them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right, fine. But if you ever find yourself on your own, call me.
Paige takes a pen and writes her number on his hand. She walks off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You sure took care of her.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She is not my type.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, okay. You know, if you're free, you should come to the New Year's Party at Jessica's house.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: There will be a lot of single girls there. Maybe one of them will be your type.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know what I love about the Italians?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Our great sense of style, humor, or... Just sense?
Paige laughs.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh no... I'm being funny!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ooh, all of the above. But I `love` your country...
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh, all of the above. But I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] your country...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We do have a beautiful country. Especially in the rural town where I am from.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh? What town is that? Are all the men there as handsome as you are?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No one is nearly as good looking...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: What am I `saying?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What am I [color=#e23b3b][i]saying?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know my parents have a villa in Tuscany. Maybe we could meet out there some day...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do you want to give me all the details of where you're from? Maybe over dinner?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is hard to say 'no'...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I should not have said that.
Matteo looks at $ZOE helplessly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, he's busy tonight. We're part of a tour.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Right. Well, don't let me keep you.
Paige turns back to Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe next time your babysitter isn't here, you can give me a call?
Paige takes a pen and writes her number on his hand. She walks away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I knew you could get back into the dating game.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, congratulations.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You know, you should come to the New Year's Party at Jessica's house. There will be a lot of single girls there.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I will think about it.
At that moment, the waitress comes up to them.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Excuse me, Ericson, party of four? Right this way.
At their table, everyone props their menus open.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This is my first time in an `American` Italian restaurant. Is there anything I should get?
nodes.text_bbcode: This is my first time in an [color=#e23b3b][i]American[/i][/color] Italian restaurant. Is there anything I should get?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I recommend a pizza. It's former President $Scott's favorite food!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So what do you think, $ZOE? Should we get the usual?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The usual? You come here often?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, but we always get the same thing in Italian restaurants.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Pasta Bolognese and a large Caesar salad.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You guys order that every time?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Something wrong with that?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No, it is just... Don't you get tired of it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's more like we know what we like.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But if you never try something new, how can you be sure that is your favorite thing?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just don't want to risk my entire meal on getting something I don't like.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We know we'll always enjoy that same meal...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, $ZOE, why don't you try some of my food? I am positive you will enjoy it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Please, I insist.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you getting?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am going to order the...

nodes.prompt: I am going to order the...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I am going to order the...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We both have girls who are devoted to someone or something else.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Unsure of whether they'd consider accepting us into their lives or not...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's a sad way to live...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: If I thought like that all the time, I would never have had the courage to come all this way.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Although the more I talk about it, the more it seems like a mistake.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Even if it's hopeless, I like to have hope...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I like being contrary!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Besides, at least you know $ZOE likes you.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And how do I know that?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You had Paris.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She did feel something for me in Paris. Maybe she can remember it again if I remind her.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But Erik, are you ever going to tell Sara how you feel?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They are?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You are unsure of Sara's feelings for you, so you cannot know whether or not she likes you.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Whereas I know that $ZOE used to have feelings for me.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Before Howard, we were a good match. We were happy together.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I have high hopes of rekindling that with $ZOE, given the right chance...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: If you want to create something special with Sara, you need to figure out if she returns your feelings.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And that means telling her how you feel.
They walk forward to catch up with Erik.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I didn't even know the school was open during winter break.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Luckily for us, it's open for athletes and clubs, so they can meet! Now if you will turn through here and look through this door...
Erik leads them into the library where Justin is studying.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Here is the library where the current President, Justin, goes about his daily business!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: From reading budget forms to vetoing student ideas, Justin is truly an inspiration!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: An honor, as always, Erik. But I'm simply a humble public servant...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: More than that! There's wide speculation that Justin is also, in fact, Santa during the holiday season! Isn't he great?
Erik leads them out of the library and into the gym.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This gym is where the athletic elites play! From basketball players to cheerleaders, this gym is where Centerscore's all-stars really shine!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: In fact, you can see some cheerleaders. They're probably poring over their Christmas cheer routines right now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey Jessica... Maria... Nicole. Was there practice today or something?
Jessica tears down a poster hanging on the wall. $ZOE can see the phrase 'Relationships Vs. Rebounds' before Jessica crumples it completely.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'd be `invited` if it were cheerleading practice, $ZOE. This is just a personal matter we're discussing.
nodes.text_bbcode: You'd be [color=#3b78e2][i]invited[/i][/color] if it were cheerleading practice, $ZOE. This is just a personal matter we're discussing.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nothing for you to worry about. Just go and make out with Howard somewhere. You two are `so cute.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nothing for you to worry about. Just go and make out with Howard somewhere. You two are [color=#3b78e2][i]so cute.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Okay...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE seems to have an entire life here with Howard, with cheerleading... Without me...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We're moving along now! Speaking of incredible athletes...
Erik leads them to a neighborhood pool where the swim team is practicing under the direction of Coach Kessler!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Jane, Sam, I want to see a more streamlined stroke. Your arms are the oars of your boat, girls!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This is the pool where Centerscore's best swimmers practice! And...
Erik points to a pretty brown-haired girl lapping her teammates on the far side of the pool.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh boy! Don't look now, but `there` is the sweet mermaid of the water, the shining pearl of the sea, the wriggling sea snake of the deep...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh boy! Don't look now, but [color=#e23b3b][i]there[/i][/color] is the sweet mermaid of the water, the shining pearl of the sea, the wriggling sea snake of the deep...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You are definitely related to Astrid.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who are we even talking about?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sara Kessler! Who knew we'd actually see a `star` on this `Star Tour?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sara Kessler! Who knew we'd actually see a [color=#e23b3b][i]star[/i][/color] on this [color=#e23b3b][i]Star Tour?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what about me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're `my` brightest star, Howard.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] brightest star, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you're mine.
Howard gives $ZOE a quick kiss.
On the other side of the pool, Coach Kessler blows a whistle.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, girls. Take a break! I expect to see you back here in ten minutes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to say 'hi' to Sam. Is that going to be all right, Tour Guide Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure. The tour is here to serve you! Just meet back here when you're ready!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll go with you, $ZOE.
$ZOE and Howard walk away while Matteo turns to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So who is this Sara Kessler?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just as I said, she's the sweet mermaid of the...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I heard that. But who is she to you? You light up when you talk of her.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sara is... Awesome! She's a great swimmer! And she's shy but nice! I like her a lot...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I may even love her!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But why the long face?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I don't think she likes me the way I like her.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You know this for a fact?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's a feeling I get. She would never talk about me the way she talks about swimming.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I shouldn't like her at all, but I can't help it. I mean, you know what it's like...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do. Of course, our situations are...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am having fun.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This is the first time I am seeing Centerscore. It's kind of exciting to explore my new school.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And it is wonderful to see it through Erik's eyes. He has a very... Colorful vision.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That he does.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, I'm enjoying myself too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you were the one who suggested stopping...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I only wanted to stop if everyone else was bored, but since both Matteo and I like it, I think we should go on.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Besides, it seems to make Erik really happy.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, let's go on then.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really? But this is the first time you're seeing Centerscore! It's your new school!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: True, but I have a feeling I will be seeing all these sights during my stay here.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is fine. We can do something else. Is there somewhere else you wanted to go, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually... I'm kind of enjoying the tour.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But you're the one who mentioned stopping.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't want to be the only one who wanted to stay...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And besides... Erik looks so overjoyed touring us around.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: If it'll make you happy, let's stick around. It's been an entire week since I've seen the school. I'm starting to miss it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! But only if Matteo doesn't mind.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: No, I would be happy to go on.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I should have just told her how I really felt about the tour...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And these are the houses around Centerscore High. If we take this street, we'll go down scenic Maple Drive...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Where star wide receiver Howard lives! He's amazing! He's caught at least one touchdown pass in every game he's played!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, I'm on board with this tour.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: That is impressive...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee, I didn't realize I was dating a celebrity.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now, if you will be so good as to park here, we can continue our journey on foot!
Erik holds a plaid umbrella high in the sky!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Follow me! This way! Chop chop!
As Erik moves blithely forward, Howard, $ZOE, and Matteo hang back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are we really going to tour our entire school?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I like Erik, but we're going to stop at all the places I see every day.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, we don't have to keep touring around the school if we don't want to... We could tell him we want to go somewhere else.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo, what do you think of the tour?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is fun to see the sights... But I do not want to bore $ZOE.

nodes.prompt: What do you think of the tour?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you think of the tour?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The city! When $ZOE came to visit, she told me of all the wonderful things she used to do here in Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm surprised you remember. That was a long time ago.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Of course. I'd never forget all the time we spent talking in France together. It was the most fun I've had.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I remember the Louvre, the city gardens, the opera house...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember how we pretended the opera house was haunted?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Ah, signorina, the opera house `is` haunted.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ah, signorina, the opera house [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] haunted.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that's certainly what that poor tourist thought when you jumped out from behind a curtain.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The city is sure to remind $ZOE of everything we used to do in Paris.
Up front, Howard grips the steering wheel tighter.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right, let's just head out.
And so for the next hour, Erik takes them on a tour of the city and surrounding areas...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's start with all the important sites of the city!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: This parking lot is where the brave soul Paul Revere was shot in the Freedom Festival Water Fight...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Did he make it?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes, he went on to live a good and dry life.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now moving on towards Centerscore High...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The park! I believe you and Howard wanted to hike.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: What better place to do it than outside?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I agree. Hey, that's the park where we went for our Valentine's picnic!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember how much it rained? We had to run into the trees just to stay dry!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Our food was so soggy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the grove we ended up in was really beautiful.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Sounds like you had many good times in the park.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, we have a lot of shared memories there...
So for the next hour, Erik takes them on a tour of the park and surrounding areas...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's start with Lake Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And this is where former President $Scott ran from the law after being unjustly committed to Boot Camp during Principal Dyre's reign...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: How dastardly!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Now moving on towards Centerscore High...
A few minutes later, all four of them pile into Howard's car and take off.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Many appreciations for the use of your car, Howard! My bike only safely seats one passenger, and safety is important!
You don't have to keep thanking me. It's really not a problem, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Star Tour thanks you for your support.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: As for our tour... I've mapped out two real special routes for our newest Centerscorian, Matteo!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, he doesn't need to know his way around that well.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nonsense, Howard. Introducing Matteo to the terrain is the crucial first step in being a good host!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: All right. Where to first?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I want Matteo to choose where we start! It's his tour after all!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Shall we go on to the downtown city square or to the park?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Which would mean more to $ZOE? She enjoyed the city of Paris while we were there, but she must enjoy nature if she was going hiking with Howard...

nodes.prompt: Which route would you like to take?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Which route would you like to take?

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: $ZOE, it is good to see you! It has been a long time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I'm glad to see you too, but... I didn't know you were in town.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you visiting?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Oh, it is more than just a visit. I'm the new exchange student at Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I could say that I was here only to experience America, to live a different life, to learn to love your version of football...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But in truth, signorina, I came to be near you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo... That's very sweet of you. And I'm flattered you'd transfer just for me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I'm with Howard now, and I don't think anything is going to change that.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Perhaps not, but you should listen to what I have to say...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Matteo.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This wasn't how I thought it would go... I'm starting to think that coming here was all a mistake...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You really should go. Howard's here right now, and if he sees you...
Just then, Matteo hears the sound of footsteps coming down the hall.
Matteo lands in the rose bushes just outside the house!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: `Aaaahhhhhh!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aaaahhhhhh![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no! Matteo, don't move... I know CPR!
Matteo bursts out of the roses and fights his way past the thorny underbrush.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just so you know... I'm an expert on spleen injuries...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is all right, my friend. I will be fine.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know Captain Quarch used the balcony of General Kataya's bedroom to quickly warn her of the alien army invasion that was coming...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But maybe you should try the door this time.
From above them, a window opens... And $ZOE pokes her head out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is going on out here?
$ZOE looks at Matteo, and her eyes widen. She shuts her window, and a minute later, the door opens.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe it's really you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Did you just fall into our rose bushes?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Uh, yes, unfortunately. I did not mean for you to see me like this...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why don't you just come in?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Erik too.
$ZOE steps aside to let them both inside.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo... I...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm with Howard now.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: That is not an answer to my question, signorina.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You want me to tell you that I still have feelings for you after all this time?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I'm telling you I can't have this conversation with you...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Because I can't...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Because I can't...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE turns and runs off.
He watches $ZOE go, holding a hand to his heart.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: She could not say she loved me...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But she never said she `didn't!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But she never said she [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And that means... I'm staying here in Centerscore!
Looks like Matteo didn't quite get the answer he wanted...
But no answer is better than a definite 'no'! Thanks to you, Matteo has some hope he can rekindle love with $ZOE.
But will Matteo and $ZOE actually get together? Find out next time on Surviving High School!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Matteo, I'm so sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't feel the same way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What we had in Paris... It's behind me now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now that I'm back in Centerscore with Howard, I don't have any feelings for you.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But I thought that this afternoon meant something...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please don't read too much into today. I know you traveled all the way here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I wanted to spend time with you because we're friends, Matteo. For old time's sake.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so sorry I don't feel the same way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you promised you'd leave it alone if I told you my true feelings.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You're right, and I'm a man of my word. I won't bother you anymore.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: And don't worry about seeing me in school. I'm not attending Centerscore this spring.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I'm going home.
A couple months later...
Matteo is relaxing on a beach, surrounded by beach bunnies.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Ladies... You are all very beautiful... But I am too heartbroken to enjoy my time with you...
Matteo takes a sip of punch when a shadow crosses his path.
He shields his eyes and looks up at the intruder.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yoo hoo! Remember me?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Astrid, you look che bella.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: As do you, my slippery cannoli... Care to take a salivating walk around the beach?
Matteo and Astrid walk down the beach.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So what do you want to talk about?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I want to talk about us. Matteo, it seems that you and I have suffered blows like whales on tarpaulin.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I don't know what that means...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You and I have both been `spurned` by love, and the lovers who have spurned us have spurned with one another!
nodes.text_bbcode: You and I have both been [color=#3b78e2][i]spurned[/i][/color] by love, and the lovers who have spurned us have spurned with one another!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: You are talking about how Howard and $ZOE dumped both of us to date each other, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I made it clear, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: So I am saying we could be as thick as a tangle of vines in a jungle...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: What better way to complete this circle of shame, this crusty tango than to date one another?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Well, I've tried to make a relationship work out of companionship and love...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So why not try to make one based off rejection?
Matteo holds his arms out!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Come here, my Norwegian codfish!
Oh no! Matteo and Astrid got together just because they were both dumped by $ZOE and Howard?
That's... Mildly disturbing. No one should be `that` desperate!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's... Mildly disturbing. No one should be [b]that[/b] desperate!

nodes.text: Try again and see if you can't get a better ending for Matteo!

Matteo wasn't the only one inspired to confess his feelings!
The next afternoon...
Erik walks back to the pool after swim practice is over.
Sara Kessler is there with the other girls as they pack their gear to go home.
Sara, can we talk for a minute?
Sure, Erik.
Hannah pats Sara on the shoulder.
Gee, I wonder what this is going to be about...
Have `fun,` you two! And make sure he takes off his glasses first, so they don't fog up!
Don't mind them.
Not minding!
They walk to the other side of the pool.
What's up, Erik?
Sara, we've had a lot of good times together.
Uh, we have?
Dancing with you, meeting your father, hanging out with your friends...
Didn't that all happen in one night? The Homecoming Dance?
Like I said, good times!
They were pretty fun.
And I'd like to have more good times with you.
What do you mean?
I like you. You are the nicest, most awesome girl in the school!
And I'd like to take you out.
Erik, that's really nice of you to say...
You're a great, funny guy, but we can't date.
I know you are very busy with your swimming schedule. A future Olympian would need to practice every day, so dating might be out of the question...
It's not that... It's just that spark, Erik. I don't feel the same way about you as I do about swimming.
And you like me more than I could like you. I think you should take a chance on someone else.
Someone great.
I understand. Thank you, Sara, for being you.
Sure thing, Erik...
Erik trudges away from the pool.
Matteo is right. I can't keep liking someone who doesn't want me...
But this definitely marks today as the `worst` Star Tour of Centerscore ever!
Awww, poor Erik! At least he figured out how Sara felt about him! But will Erik ever find true love?

nodes.title: Christmas Exchange
nodes.subtitle: There's a new arrival in town!

nodes.text: It's a couple days after Christmas... And Centerscore is getting ready for a new arrival!
At $ZOE's house, $ZOE and Howard are preparing for an afternoon hike when she receives a text message!
$ZOE glances at the caller ID and frowns.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I never thought I'd hear from `him` again...
nodes.text_bbcode: I never thought I'd hear from [color=#3b78e2][i]him[/i][/color] again...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'It is hard to talk when one is half a world away...' What does this text mean?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, do you know where I put my sunglasses? I just had them...
$ZOE hastily tucks her phone in her pocket.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nope. Haven't seen them.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Never mind. They're... On my head.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee.
At the Ericson household, Erik strings up macaroni streamers and attaches red, green, and white posters to the wall in preparation...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh boy, oh boy! His plane landed half an hour ago! That means he's coming here now!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm so eager to meet him! I've decorated his room and everything!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hope he likes pasta...
Just then... The doorbell rings.
Erik runs downstairs. He flings the door open to reveal...
The handsome, Italian soccer-player `Matteo!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The handsome, Italian soccer-player [b]Matteo![/b]

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Hello Centerscore! I am here!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Welcome to America! I'm Erik Ericson, Astrid's brother.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Ah yes! Hello, Erik! Astrid sends you many warm holiday greetings.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I believe she wants you to 'cling to Christmas joy like a starving octopus to a luscious starfish'.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She talks about sea creatures a lot...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: As I have noticed. I also come bearing gifts. Here is a late holiday gift to thank you for hosting me.
Matteo hands Erik a present. Erik opens it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Socks! My feet thank you!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: It is nothing. But I have one more gift to deliver today... Quick, we have somewhere to be!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know! We have an exciting day ahead of us!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: In anticipation of your arrival, I've planned the amazing, the illustrious, the incredibly safe `Star Tour of Centerscore!`
nodes.text_bbcode: In anticipation of your arrival, I've planned the amazing, the illustrious, the incredibly safe [color=#e23b3b][i]Star Tour of Centerscore![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's a way for you to get to know the famous people in this town by visiting our exciting historical sites!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Where do you want to begin? The Concrete Sidewalk of Stardom? The School Hall of Fame?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Erik, all those places sound amazing, but there is something I must do before that.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: The reason I transferred to Centerscore High is to be near $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: $ZOE? You mean, Howard's $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I do not quite think of her that way... But, yes, I talk of that $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: We parted just half a year ago when she decided to live in Centerscore, and I have not forgotten her.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I have tried. I dated a few girls... They were beautiful, charming, and nice...

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But I did not feel for any of them the way I feel for $ZOE. There was never the same spark.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Each relationship only proved even more that $ZOE was the only one in my heart.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I had one serious girlfriend. We dated for a month, and I thought maybe she would be someone I could fall for.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: But I could not love her. I could not stop thinking of $ZOE, wondering what might have been.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: This has never happened to me before. I broke up with my girlfriend, and that is when I knew I had to come to Centerscore to see $ZOE again.

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: I am just lucky the exchange program let me transfer in at the semester break. I thought I might have to wait an entire year!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: So now that I have the chance to see her, I'm going to her house to...

nodes.prompt: I'm going to her house to...
